memos.argument: Polyester/epoxy powder coatings with pigments are paints based on synthetic polymers; 3208 covers paints and varnishes based on synthetic polymers, and 3208.10 is specifically 'Based on polyesters' (3.7%). If polyester is the predominant resin, the eo nomine polyester subheading fits. Chapter 32 note 3 confirms pigmented preparations for paints sit in ch. 32, not ch. 39.
exclusions_against: Heading text requires polymers 'dispersed or dissolved in a nonaqueous medium'; a dry powder has no medium, so 3208 fits poorly (this is the usual reason powder coatings go to 3210).
Chapter 32 note 4 (solutions in volatile solvents) does not apply to dry powder.
Polyester vs epoxy predominance unknown (polyester/epoxy hybrid); if epoxy predominates, 3208.90 (Other) applies.
cross_search returned no on-point ruling for powder coatings.

memos.argument: 3210 is the residual paints/varnishes heading: 'Other paints and varnishes'. A pigmented dry powder coating applied to metal surfaces is a paint in function and end use but is not dispersed/dissolved in a nonaqueous (3208) or aqueous (3209) medium, so it falls in the residual 'other paints' heading. Single 10-digit subheading, 1.8%.
exclusions_against: Chapter 32 note 3 notes that other preparations of 3208-3210 are outside 3203-3206 but does not itself place powders in 3210.
If product is unpigmented/clear resin without colorant, it may be a plastic in primary form (3907) rather than a paint.
cross_search returned no on-point ruling; no tool evidence that powder coatings are classed in 3210.

memos.argument: The product is a polyester/epoxy resin powder; epoxide resins in primary forms (powders are a primary form) are in 3907.30 and polyesters in 3907.69/3907.29. If the pigment is a minor additive, the resin is the essential character.
exclusions_against: Chapter 39 note 2 and Section/Ch.32 structure: pigmented, formulated coating preparations ready for application as paint belong in ch. 32 (3208-3210); product is described as 'powder coatings' with pigments for coating metal.
Mixture of polyester and epoxy is a blend/formulated compound with curing agents and pigments, not a plain primary-form polymer.
